items.details: Three Floyds Brewing · American Pale Ale · 6.5% ABV

items.details: Lagunitas Brewing Company · American Pale Wheat Ale · 7.5% ABV
items.description: Lagunitas' smooth-drinking wheat IPA — silky, citrusy, and loaded with hop flavor. A cult favorite that goes down way too easy on game day.

items.description: Bell's legendary IPA — bursting with grapefruit and pine from 100% Centennial hops. Perfectly balanced, endlessly drinkable, and a must-have for any hop lover on game day.

items.details: Firestone Walker Brewing Company · Mexican Lager · 4.5% ABV

items.description: Lagunitas' flagship IPA — bold, hoppy, and endlessly drinkable. A West Coast classic that never misses.
